narrative.intro: Bechtel National reported $1.1B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Bechtel National recorded 1 award so far in the fiscal year, producing an average award size of $1.1B, and obligations are up 7.4% year over year. Historical annual obligations show variation: FY21 was $1.2B, FY22 was $763M, FY23 was $986M, FY24 was $929M, and FY25 was $1.1B. Bechtel National has returned to the $1.1B level this fiscal year after a dip in FY22 and a recovery through FY23–FY25. The current-year totals are partial because the period is fiscal year to date, and the figures shown are contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Bechtel National’s single current award accounts for the full FY2026 obligations shown here given the matching $1.1B award-size and total obligations figures.
